newsitem.title: USA: SOCCER-PERU OPENS USA CUP WITH 1-0 OVER THE HOSTS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PERU OPENS USA CUP WITH 1-0 OVER THE HOSTS.

text.p: Peru spoiled opening night for the hosts, beating the United States 1-0 in the first game of the U.S. Cup soccer tournament Friday at Jack Murphy Stadium.

Peru scored the contest's only goal in the eighth minute. Alex Magallanes sent a high cross from the right wing to German Carty, who headed the ball from eight metres to the right of U.S. goalkeeper Brad Friedel.

The U.S. team had their best chance to tie in the 71st minute. Claudio Reyna chipped a ball from midfield to Jason Kreis, who sent a high cross from the right wing to Alexi Lalas. But Lalas's header from five metres just cleared the crossbar.
Both teams played a possession game, but the Peruvians reacted more quickly to the ball. Peru controlled the first half with superior ball control, passing and defensive positioning.

The United States had several chances to equalise after Jovan Kirovski entered the game as an attacking midfielder in the 55th minute. The Americans took eight of their 11 total shots in the second half.
Both teams missed key players. Peru played without starting forwards Flavio Maestri and Julinho, who play in Spain's First Division.
The United States missed playmaking midfielders John Harkes and Tab Ramos, striker Eric Wynalda and defender Marcelo Balboa. All four are recovering from injuries.
Peru next meet Denmark on Sunday, while the hosts take on Mexico.

United States: Brad Friedel; Mike Burns, Frankie Hejduk (Jason Kreis, 60th), Alexi Lalas, Jeff Agoos; Preki Radosavljevic (Cobi Jones, 78th), Claudio Reyna, Steve Ralston (Jovan Kirovski, 55); Brian McBride, Roy Lassiter, Joe Max-Moore.

Peru: Julio Balerio; Alfonso Dulanto, Nolberto Solano, Juan Reynoso, Percy Olivares; Juan Jayo, Roger Serrano, Alex Magallenes (Waldir Saenz, 58th), Paolo Maldonaldo, Jose Pereda; German Carty (Roberto Farfan, 68th).
